answer: A route-planning market for walks that wander through juniper toward the ocean can allocate service slots by capital-time rather than account count. For each epoch, integrate each deposit's locked amount over time and divide a fixed slot budget in proportion to that total. Track deposits globally so the same units cannot back overlapping claims; give no signup allocation. Splitting one deposit among aliases leaves its combined share unchanged. Increasing that share requires locking more capital for longer and paying its financing cost.
